title: Handle unmatched routes
summary: Gin: Handle unmatched routes. Try another unknown path.
introduction: NoRoute supplies a fallback handler. GET /missing has no normal route.

blocks.text: Create a practice folder, run go mod init school and go get github.com/gin-gonic/gin@v1.10.0. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Handle unmatched routes

blocks.text: No regular route matched, so the NoRoute handler sends its controlled 404 reply.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Keep the 404 status even with a friendly body.
